items.title: India's festive demand is uneven as inflation, price hikes weigh on shoppers
items.summary: While consumer demand remains resilient across consumer categories, demand shows signs of stress in pockets due to inflation from the West Asia war.

items.title: Nifty faces key 23,200 hurdle, analysts remain cautious
items.summary: Nifty has recently surged by nearly 2%, approaching the resistance level at 23,200. Analysts recommend building long positions to capitalize on a potential breakout. Support is set between 22,600 and 22,800, serving as a buffer. Recommended stocks for investment this week include DLF and Zensar Technologies. Investors should exercise caution in the broader market until significant resistance levels are broken.

items.title: Air India weighs Singapore Airlines executive for CFO as losses mount
items.summary: Air India's management has held preliminary discussions on the appointment with Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran and Air India chief executive officer (CEO) Tewolde Gebremariam, both of whom are understood to be supportive of the move.

items.title: GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October as festive demand beats high inflation and interest rates
items.summary: India's GST collections in October reached ₹2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a 22.9% year-on-year increase. Strong consumption trends are indicated by rising passenger car sales and record digital payments. Power consumption also surged nearly 22% compared to last year, further emphasizing economic strength. Despite a high inflation rate of 5.5%, demand has remained robust, supporting growth forecasts. Analysts suggest…

items.title: TSMC’s $265 Billion Campus Is Driving a Real Estate Boom in the Phoenix Suburbs
items.summary: The world’s biggest chipmaker is pulling in suppliers, home builders and Taiwanese investors who have seen firsthand how the company can change a local economy.

items.title: Wall Street Braces for Biggest Treasury Sales Overhaul in Years
items.summary: After Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent surprised dealers with his willingness to intervene in the bond market to drive down yields in recent months, Wall Street is now girding for the biggest revamp in guidance for US Treasuries issuance since early 2024.

items.title: One nation, many opportunities: Why India's many elections may be keeping protests peaceful
items.summary: People across India are protesting peacefully, contrasting with violent agitations seen in other countries. The 'one nation, multiple elections' framework allows diverse political benefits to be shared among parties. This electoral model keeps governments accountable and responsive to public needs. Elections help to channel frustrations and enable citizens to express their concerns. As a result, the political…

items.title: PM Modi to meet Niti Aayog leadership on Nov 5; likely to review work as govt begins shaping FY28 Budget
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to meet the new leadership of Niti Aayog on November 5. This meeting aims to establish budget priorities amidst global uncertainty and economic growth challenges. The focus will be on enhancing domestic manufacturing and creating employment opportunities. Experts from various sectors will provide insights related to India's development objectives.

items.title: CII calls for GST-like reforms in land, labour & local approvals
items.summary: CII has called for extending the GST Council's approach to decriminalise offences in various sectors. This move aims to enhance ease of doing business and attract investments in land, labour, and construction. The organisation emphasizes the importance of simplifying regulatory processes across different government tiers.

items.title: PNB union seeks audit of 10,500 branches after ₹11.24 cr fraud, multiple suspensions; warns against ‘knee-jerk’ action
items.summary: The Punjab National Bank's union has urged the management to audit all 10,500 branches and examine staffing, training, security and management oversight after alleged fraud at its Greater Noida branch. Details here.

items.title: Ashwini Vaishnaw reviews Bharat-made B28 bullet train manufacturing at BEML
items.summary: The minister examined specialised manufacturing infrastructure, quality assurance procedures and key components designed to meet high-speed rail operational standards

items.summary: The transmission major also reported higher quarterly income, substantial capital expenditure and 99.81 per cent average transmission system availability

items.title: Crash! Gold price suffers worst October in years: Did silver and platinum suffer too? Check monthly performance
items.summary: Precious metals fell sharply in October as energy prices, inflation concerns and expectations of higher US interest rates weighed on markets. Silver recorded the steepest monthly decline at 19.17%, followed by platinum at 16.65% and gold at 7.23%.

items.title: Hero, Honda gain ground as October two-wheeler retail jumps 29%

items.title: Emami vs Dabur FMCG shares Q2 results preview: Profit, revenue expectations; Dividend announcements in focus
items.summary: Emami and Dabur are set to announce Q2FY27 results on November 5 and 4, respectively, and may declare interim dividends. Analysts expect revenue growth of 20% for Emami and 11% for Dabur, while adjusted profit is forecast to rise 4% and 9%, respectively.

items.title: DivyaSree Developers, HDFC Capital partner to set up ₹1,500 crore residential platform
items.summary: The partnership aims to build a ₹6,750 crore development pipeline over the next three to four years as the commercial property developer accelerates its residential expansion across major Indian cities.

items.title: Gold, silver may extend losses as US vote, jobs data test sentiment
items.summary: Gold and silver may extend their losses as investors track the US midterm election, jobs data, geopolitical tensions and global economic indicators for cues on bullion prices.

items.title: Why did Amazon cut 250 jobs in its devices unit despite new product launches? What employees were told
items.summary: Amazon has cut up to 250 jobs in its devices and services division, mainly affecting software development roles. The company cited efficiency and changes to its product plans, while employees were informed through early morning texts and emails.

items.title: ITC Q2 results 2026 preview: Will cigarette business drive growth? Profit, revenue expectations - share price target
items.summary: ITC is set to report its Q2 FY2026-27 results, with analysts expecting FMCG revenue growth but flat margins and weaker cigarette performance. Forecasts point to declines in consolidated earnings and cigarette volumes. The shares closed at ₹265.60 on Friday, down 27% so far in 2026.

items.title: Saffron blooms in Leh within 30 days in high-altitude cultivation experiment
items.summary: If successful, the experiment could open new opportunities for commercial cultivation, generate livelihoods and encourage agro-based entrepreneurship among local farmers and young people

items.title: Cash rewards coming? PFC, CONCOR, RITES, to Sonata- These firms to announce dividend with Q2 results 2026 this week
items.summary: At least 20 companies are scheduled to report Q2FY27 results this week, alongside dividend announcements. Companies to watch include Power Finance Corporation, CONCOR, RITES, Sonata Software, NLC India, Aurobindo Pharma and Emami.

items.title: India's 10-year bond yield may ease to 6.75-7% by March: SBI Research
items.summary: SBI Research sees the 10-year G-sec yield easing by March 2027, citing historical yield spreads and steps to lower government borrowing, despite a possible 50-basis-point rate hike.

items.title: SEBI proposal may open up data, technology businesses for exchanges, depositories
items.summary: Market infrastructure institutions could get greater flexibility to expand related businesses and deploy subsidiary earnings, subject to tighter board oversight and safeguards against conflicts of interest

items.title: Sebi to delist penny stocks: Market regulator plans AI-based surveillance of such firms
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India plans to delist companies that have no economic activity. This move aims to protect investors, especially those investing in penny stocks. The regulator highlights the potential dangers posed by such inactive companies in the market. Additionally, Sebi intends to announce compliance requirements for foreign institutional investors soon.

items.title: Syngene expects stronger H2 on order book, Zoetis supplies; retains outlook
items.summary: Syngene International expects a stronger second half of FY27, driven by its order book and Zoetis supplies, while retaining guidance for a single-digit revenue decline.
